items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: I mean I guess like Herbie Hancock and some of them are making a decent living, you know, but how many Herbies they got?

ctx.x: Well it sounds like regarding making a living in jazz music, it sounds like you’re saying that’s almost impossible these days. If you want, because the essence of jazz now is that it’s not going to be a hitmaker, so getting back to you tell your students, like you want to make a living as a jazz musician, sort of good luck, but make sure you’ve got that degree also.
That’s right. Or get you a day job. I mean let’s face, I mean I guess like Herbie Hancock and some of them are making a decent living, you know, but how many Herbies they got?
Right. How much room is there at the top.
